title: On Suspending the business until the spring
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：suspend　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 suspend 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the doctor ① suspended the business until the spring in silence, and every patient in the clinic said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the doctor ② suspends the business until the spring twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ suspend the business until the spring at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ suspended the business until the spring before — a line in the chart for January 1982 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Suspending the business until the spring in silence, the doctor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ suspend the lamps from the highest beam twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Suspend the lamps from the highest beam at once and never mention it again.

By 1995 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the chart, and a new patient from the next clinic ⑧ suspends the lamps from the highest beam in silence every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ suspended the business until the spring again when nobody else would.

⑩ To suspend the business until the spring, my mother said in 2000, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the clinic remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the clinic forgets, somebody suspends the business until the spring twice over again and somebody must suspend the business until the spring in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 暂停（一般过去式 suspended the business until the spring：1988 年大夫头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 暂停（一般现在 suspends the business until the spring：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 暂停（不定式 to suspend the business until the spring：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 暂停（过去完成时 had suspended the business until the spring：1982 年一月的病历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 暂停（动名词 suspending the business until the spring 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 悬挂（suspend the lamps from the highest beam：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去悬挂把灯吊在最高那根梁上）
G. v. 悬挂（suspend the lamps from the highest beam：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 暂停（后段两处：新来的病人照例 suspends the lamps from the highest beam，而母亲又一次 suspended the business until the spring）

answers.why: suspend 意为“暂停”，1988 年大夫一言不发地暂停把这事暂停到开春，那是卫生所里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 suspended。
suspend 意为“暂停”，自那以后大夫来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 suspends。
suspend 意为“暂停”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯暂停把这事暂停到开春”，此处为不定式 to suspend the business until the spring。
suspend 意为“暂停”，病历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1995 年之前就有人暂停过，故用过去完成时 had suspended。
suspend 意为“暂停”，大夫说“暂停把这事暂停到开春这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 suspending the business until the spring 作主语。
suspend 意为“悬挂”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去悬挂把灯吊在最高那根梁上”，should ever 之后用原形 suspend the lamps from the highest beam。
suspend 意为“悬挂”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻悬挂把灯吊在最高那根梁上（suspend the lamps from the highest beam at once），以后再也不要提起。
suspend 意为“暂停”，新来的病人每个星期都照例悬挂把灯吊在最高那根梁上，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 suspends。
suspend 意为“暂停”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地暂停把这事暂停到开春，用一般过去式 suspended 叙述。
suspend 意为“暂停”，结尾那句是母亲 2000 年的话：要暂停把这事暂停到开春，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和卫生所记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 suspend 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the doctor suspended the business until the spring in silence, and nobody in the clinic forgot it.
Even now the doctor suspends the business until the spring twice over whenever the clinic asks.
Suspending the business until the spring in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever suspend the lamps from the highest beam twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new patient from the next clinic suspends the lamps from the highest beam in silence every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother suspended the business until the spring again, and the clinic remembered that half.
